title: Literally Burned Out - Not Safe
text: Literally Burned Out - Not Safe. In an earlier review I dis'd the labels wearing off...this is a much bigger NO!  I've owned this burner for almost a year, but I only use this to save on using the gas range when I'm cooking something that has a long cook time, like stew.  There has been much less than 40 hours of actual use.  After an hour of simmering soup, I went into the kitchen to see smoke pouring out of the power dial and smelled wire burning.  Needless to say, I am beyond dissatisfied with this burner.
